snippet.title: Robot Rivals - Launch Trailer | free browser robot combat with flywheel physics
snippet.description:
Robot Rivals is heavyweight robot combat in your browser. Four 113 kg spinners, one steel box, and every weapon is simulated as a flywheel, so how hard you hit comes out of the physics. Drive your spinner into the wall at full speed and it throws you back. Free, no install, 1v1 online or two players on one keyboard.

The fights in this trailer are real gameplay from the launch build (CPU vs CPU), recorded frame by frame with the game's own sound.

Free on itch.io from Thursday 24 September 2026, 15:00 CEST: https://hakman-dev.itch.io/robot-rivals
Discord: https://discord.gg/HkPkbBNKVM

Sound: announcer and impact sounds by Kenney (kenney.nl), metal foley by Nox_Sound and falling debris by xkeril (freesound.org), all CC0.
